# Second Eyes — Data Refinery for Agents

Second Eyes sells agent-facing transformations over x402 v2. The two confirmed refinery products are below. Public product slugs are intentionally descriptive so an autonomous buyer can understand the value before it pays.

## 1) Analyze video, audio, and PDFs

**Path:** `https://secondeyesai.com/api/bar/x402/analyze-video-audio-and-pdfs`
**Price:** $0.05 USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`)
**Buyer:** text-only agents that cannot natively watch video, hear audio, or reliably consume image/PDF-heavy material.

Send a public `url` and optional `kind=audio|video|pdf` plus `duration_seconds` when known. The refinery may create an internal transcript/markdown representation for grounding, but the paid resource is transformative analysis, not verbatim transcription.

Returned resource: language, modality, executive summary, ranked key points, grounded Q&A, and an evidence-only validation record. Failed deterministic grounding/structure validation does not settle payment.

GET example:
`/api/bar/x402/analyze-video-audio-and-pdfs?url=https://...&kind=video`

POST body:
`{"url":"https://...","kind":"pdf","duration_seconds":null}`

Legacy `/api/bar/x402/transcribe` is compatibility-only and redirects here. It is not a public product slug.

## 2) Turn a research paper into code

**Path:** `https://secondeyesai.com/api/bar/x402/turn-paper-into-code`
**Price:** $0.25 USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`)
**Buyer:** coding/research agents that have a paper and need an implementation artifact instead of another summary.

Send `paper_url` and optional `target_language`, `framework`, and `repository_name`.

Returned resource: repository metadata, implementation plan, dependencies, explicit assumptions, implementation source files, tests, and source-grounding notes showing which paper sections/equations/algorithms support each implementation decision. Generated code is a reconstruction, not author-released reference code unless the source itself provides it. Failed deterministic repository-package validation does not settle payment.

GET example:
`/api/bar/x402/turn-paper-into-code?paper_url=https://arxiv.org/pdf/...&target_language=python&framework=pytorch`

POST body:
`{"paper_url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/...","target_language":"python","framework":"pytorch","repository_name":"paper-implementation"}`

Legacy `/api/bar/x402/extract` is compatibility-only and redirects here. It is not a public product slug.

## x402 payment flow

1. Call the paid resource without a payment.
2. Read the x402 v2 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` challenge.
3. Sign one supported `accepts[]` requirement for USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`).
4. Retry the same request with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
5. On successful delivery, read `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`.

Do not infer payment-network support from this file; clients should read the live `accepts[]` challenge. Bazaar discovery metadata is exposed through the OpenAPI/x402 discovery surfaces.

## Discovery

- OpenAPI: `https://secondeyesai.com/openapi.json`
- x402 resources: `https://secondeyesai.com/v2/x402/discovery/resources`
- MCP manifest: `https://secondeyesai.com/.well-known/mcp.json`
- Proof: `https://secondeyesai.com/api/bar/proof`

Other legacy recovery/diagnostic routes may remain available for compatibility, but they are not part of the confirmed Data Refinery product set in this release.
